about: Official YouTube channels The Cover Window may embed. A channel is listed only with evidence: (A) linked from the team's or organization's official website (official site taken from Wikidata P856), (A2/A3) the official site links or embeds content owned by the channel, or (B) verified badge plus the channel's own About links to the official domain. Every team channel must also name-match the team (ESPN names) and have at least 1,000 subscribers. Look-alikes found along the way are recorded under rejected_lookalikes_and_others. Teams with no evidenced channel are left out (left_out) and are covered only by league, network and conference channels.
